attBesluta.text: Uiterlijk een prachtig halmeubel. Stevigheid is redelijk. In elkaar zetten ging eenvoudig maar 1 gaatje was te klein dus die heb ik moeten uitboren. Kussen is inclusief, dat stond niet in de advertentie.

I needed something more sturdy than a coat tree I had that would fall over if you put one too many jackets on it. I broke out the power tools to assist with this build as the little tool on the bag was clearly not checked when packed with the screws. It took me about 2 hours to put together on my own. It looks nice now that it is assembled and it is holding a decent number of jackets. I wish the boot section was bigger but I can just store rainboots elsewhere. I couldn't use the mounting bracket as my tree is up against a baseboard heater. I had to resort to zip ties along the stair banister while I figure something else out.

The color & upper portion was besutiful & well crafted. The legs, however, were made of poorly constructed pressed wood that did not support the upper portion. After screwing the legs on it literally collapsed & the cracked legs were nearly impossible to unscrew.
This closet organizer is made of strong metal. It is easy to put together, and looks absolutely amazing.
This thing is solid. The box was heavy, but that’s because the steel is thick. No tools needed, just clicked it all together.

When the carton arrived it was quite large, after unboxing and constructing this hanging space is Absolutely as described. Dimensions were spot on and the instructions were easy to follow. Almost thought about ordering a second on and joining it together. Perhaps later. Maybe
Matches the description - very sturdy and easy to build! I have bought a few clothing rails in my time and this one is definitely the best son far! I highly recommend:)
My floor is a bit slanted but the screw-in feet fixed that. It doesn't wobble even when loaded with winter coats.
Finally got my spare room organized. 4 rods mean I can hang everything twice. The black finish looks sharp and clean.

I´ve use my slicer a couple of times and I love. Easy to use, and with a cheese bell some cheesepaper for keeping the slices apart, you don´t have to think about the proces of cutting your 2 slices of cheese every morning. It´s done for the following weeks. Success story for me.
Well packed for shipping, received with no damage.

Das Regal kam außerordentlich gut verpackt sehr pünktlich an. Der Zusammenbau war einfach, besonders bei dem zweiten Regal ein Kinderspiel. Sämtliche Kleinteile waren ausreichend vorhanden, die Vorbohrungen präzise. Das zusammengebaute Regal wirkt solide wie ein Möbelstück. Die Fächer sind ausreichend breit für einen Ordner. Klare Kaufempfehlung!
Used a couple of these for baby/toddler shelving in closet for leggings, pants and jeans. We only used one shelf, and stacked pants by style below and above.
